_comment: Core setup tasks: work a kit release adds that only the installer can do.
`exakit update` compares these names with core_tasks.completed in the
laptop's manifest.json. Any name not recorded there is pending, and a
pending task makes the update rerun the downloaded installer once. The
installer holds the actual setup and its checks; this file only asks for
name   a permanent key. Append new entries and keep the old ones for users
who skip releases. Never rename or reuse a name: a later setup pass
for the same component gets a new one (preprocessor_v2).
scope  the installer step that performs the task: database (Step 4,
Configure database features) or kit (local, no database needed).
Only add a task when a new addition needs the installer to run after an
update. A component that `exakit update` can install by itself does not.
